country_event = {
	id = cosmo_usort_events.120
	title = cosmo_usort_events.120.t
	desc = cosmo_usort_events.120.d
	picture = DIPLOMACY_eventPicture
	goto = dipcapital

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		}
		
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_give_colony
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = dipcountry
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = dipcapital
					}
				}								
			random_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible  
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_1	
			save_event_target_as = colonist1	
			}
			random_owned_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible  														
				NOT = {

					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_2		
			save_event_target_as = colonist2	
			}
			random_owned_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible  														
				NOT = {

					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_2	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_3		
			save_event_target_as = colonist3	
			}
			random_owned_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible  														
				NOT = {

					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_2	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_3	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_4		
			save_event_target_as = colonist4	
			}
			random_owned_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible  														
				NOT = {

					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_2	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_3	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_4	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_5		
			save_event_target_as = colonist5	
			}
			random_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible 
				OR = {
					any_neighbor_province = {
						NOT = {
							country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
						}
					}
					is_island = yes
				}			 														
				NOT = {

					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_2	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_3	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_4	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_5	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_6		
			save_event_target_as = colonist6	
			}
			random_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible 
				OR = {
					any_neighbor_province = {
						NOT = {
							country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
						}
					}
					is_island = yes
				}			 														
				NOT = {
					has_province_flag = sell_province_1	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_2	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_3	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_4	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_5	
					has_province_flag = sell_province_6	
				}					
				}
			set_province_flag = sell_province_7		
			save_event_target_as = colonist7	
			}
			random_province = {
				limit = {
							has_province_flag = cosmo_colony_eligible 
				OR = {

						is_subject_of_type = cosmo_african_personal_union_GCDJM			
				}				
			}
			create_subject = {
				subject_type = cosmo_african_personal_union_CDJM
				subject = event_target:personalunion
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:personalunion = {
						is_subject_of_type = cosmo_african_personal_union_GCDJMR			
				}				
			}
			create_subject = {
				subject_type = cosmo_african_personal_union_CDJMR
				subject = event_target:personalunion
			}
		}		
	}
	event_target:personalunion = {
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_changing_PU			
	}																								
	}
	after = {
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_tariffpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_divertpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_manpowerpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_joinpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_diplopu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_culturepu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_add_tributepu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_tariffpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_divertpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_manpowerpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_joinpu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_diplopu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_culturepu
		clr_country_flag = cosmo_remove_tributepu

	}			
}

# remove join wars
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_usort_events.50
	title = cosmo_usort_events.50.t
	desc = cosmo_usort_events.50.d
	picture = DIPLOMACY_eventPicture
	goto = pucapital


	hidden = no

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		any_subject_country = {
			has_country_flag = cosmo_has_no_joinwars
			is_at_war = no			
		}
		is_at_war = no
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = cosmo_remove_joinpu
		}
		}

		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}			
		
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_has_no_joinwars
				}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					set_country_flag = in_case_there_are_two
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = pucapital
					}
				}																													
		}				
		}

	option = {#add opinion modifier to track
		name = cosmo_usort_events.50.a
		event_target:personalunion = {
			set_country_flag = cosmo_changing_PU
		}	
		set_country_flag = cosmo_remove_joinpu
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_usort_events.5
		}																														
	}			
}
